name: GreenEcho Floating Chat Button
author: prakash1234sahu

sections.description:
GreenEcho Floating Chat Button provides a seamless way for your customers to reach out to you via WhatsApp with a single click. Optimized for speed and mobile users.

Why choose GreenEcho?
In a crowded market of chat plugins, GreenEcho stands out by being developer-friendly and extremely easy to configure. We don’t load heavy libraries or tracking scripts, making it one of the fastest solutions available in the WordPress directory.

Key Features

  • Zero Lag: Highly optimized code that loads only after the page content to maintain high PageSpeed scores.
  • Mobile Optimized: Provides a seamless experience for mobile users with direct app triggers.
  • Custom Branding: Easily configure agent names and numbers to match your business identity.
  • Lightweight UI: A clean, modern SVG-based icon that looks great on any screen resolution (Retina ready).
  • Privacy Focused: We respect your users’ privacy. No third-party tracking, no cookies, and no data collection.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> GreenEcho Chat menu to configure your agent’s name and WhatsApp number.
  4. The floating button will automatically appear on your website frontend.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect site speed?

Absolutely not. GreenEcho is built with performance in mind and uses inline CSS and SVGs to minimize HTTP requests.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

No, it works with both personal and business WhatsApp accounts.

Can I change the button position?

Currently, the button is fixed at the bottom-right for the best user experience. More options are coming in future updates!
